dhātu agni praharaṇa sāhasaiḥ kuja aṃśe saumya aṃśe lipi gaṇitā ādi kāvya śilpaiḥ praharṣiṇī
jīva aṃśe dvija vibudha ākara ādi dharmaiḥ kāvya aṃśe maṇi rajata ādi go mahiṣyaiḥ

mitra ari sva gṛha gataiḥ grahaiḥ tatas artham tuṅga sthe balini ca bhāskare sva vīryāt
āya sthaiḥ udaya dhana āśritaiḥ ca saumyaiḥ saṃcintyam bala sahitaiḥ anekadhā svam praharṣiṇī
rājayoga
prāhuḥ yavanāḥ sva tuṅga gaiḥ krūraiḥ krūra matiḥ mahīpatiḥ
krūraiḥ tuna jīvaśarmaṇaḥ pakṣe kṣiti adhipaḥ prajāyate vaitālīya
vakra arka ja arka gurubhiḥ sakalaiḥ tribhiḥ ca sva ucca iṣu ṣoḍaśa nṛpāḥ kathita eka lagne
dvi eka āśriteṣu ca tathā ekatame vilagne sva kṣetra ge śaśini ṣoḍaśa bhūmipāḥ syuḥ vasantatilakā
varga auttama gate lagne candra iva a candra varjitaḥ
catura ādyaiḥ grahaiḥ dṛṣṭe nṛpāḥ dvā viṃśatiḥ smṛtāḥ anuṣṭubh
yame kumbhe arke aje gavi śaśini taiḥ eva tanugaiḥ nṛ yuktim saha ali sthaiḥ śaśija guru vakraiḥ nṛpatayaḥ
yama aindū tuṅge aṅge savitṛ śaśi jau ṣaṣṭha bhavane tulā aja aindu kṣetraiḥ sa sita kuja jīvaiḥ ca nara pau śikhariṇī
kuje tuṅge arka endvoḥ dhanuṣi yama lagne ca kupatiḥ patiḥ bhūmeḥ ca anyaḥ kṣitisuta vilagne sa śaśini
sa candre saure aste surapati gurau cāpa dhara ge sva tuṅga sthe bhānau udayam upayātā kṣitipatiḥ śikhariṇī
vṛṣe saindau lagne savitṛ guru tīkṣṇa aṃśu tanayaiḥ suhṛd jāyā kha sthaiḥ bhavati niyamāt mānava patiḥ
mṛge mande lagne sahaja ripu dharma vyaya gataiḥ śaśa aṅka ādyaiḥ khyātaḥ pṛthu guṇa yaśāḥ puṅgala patiḥ śikhariṇī
haye saindau jīve mṛga mukha gate bhūmitanaye sva tuṅga sthau lagne bhṛguja śaśijā vatra nṛpatī
su tasthau vakra arkī guru śaśi sitāḥ ca api hi buke budhe kanyā lagne bhavati hi nṛpaḥ anyaḥ api guṇavān śikhariṇī
jhaṣe saindau lagne ghaṭa mṛga mṛga aindra iṣu sahitaiḥ yama āra arkaiḥ yaḥ abhūt sa khalu manujaḥ śāsti vasudhām
ajesāre mūrtau śaśi gṛha gate ca amaragurau sura ijyā iva ālagne dharaṇipatiḥ anyaḥ api guṇavān śikhariṇī
karkiṇi lagne tad sthe jīve candra sita jñaiḥ āya prāptaiḥ
meṣa gate arke jātam vidyāt vikrama yuktam pṛthvīnātham vidyunmālā

sa jīve aste niśānāthe rājāmanda ārayoḥ sute anuṣṭubh

ucca sva trikoṇa gaiḥ bala sthaiḥ tri ādyaiḥ bhūpati vaṃśa ja anara indrāḥ

sva ṛkṣe śukre pātāla sthe dharma sthānam prāpte candre

dharma artha aupacayeṣu avaśeṣaiḥ dharma ātmā nṛpajaḥ pṛthivī īśaḥ navamālikā

na ābhasayoga
nava diś vasavaḥ trika agni vedaiḥ guṇitāḥ dvi tri catur vikalpa jāḥ syuḥ
yavanaiḥ triguṇa ahi ṣaṭśatī sā kathita a vistarataḥ agra tad samāḥ syuḥ aupacchandasika
rajjuḥ muśalam nalaḥ cara ādyaiḥ satyaḥ ca āśraya ja ān jagāda yogān
kendraiḥ sat asat yutaiḥ dala ākhyau sraj sarpau kathitau parāśareṇa aupacchandasika
yogāḥ vrajanti āśraya jāḥ sama tvam yava abja vajra aṇḍa ja golaka ādyaiḥ
kendraupagaiḥ prokta phalau dala ākhyau iti āhuḥ anyena pṛthak phalau tau upajātikā
āsanna kendra bhavana dvaya gaiḥ gadā ākhyaḥ tanu asta ga iṣu śakaṭam vihagaḥ khabandhvoḥ
śṛṅgāṭakam navama pañcama lagna saṃsthaiḥ lagna anya gaiḥ halam iti pravadanti tad jñāḥ vasantatilakā
śakaṭa aṇḍaja vat śubha aśubaiḥ vajram tad viparīta gaiḥ yavaḥ
kamalaṃtu vimiśra saṃsthitaiḥ vā api tat yadi kendra bāhyatas vaitālīyā
pūrva śāstra anusāreṇa mayā vajra ādayaḥ kṛtāḥ
cauturthe bhavane sūryāt jña sitau bhavataḥ katham anuṣṭubh
kaṇṭaka ādi pravṛttaiḥ tu caturgṛha gataiḥ grahaiḥ
yūpa iṣu śakti daṇḍa ākhyā horā ādyaiḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ kramāt anuṣṭubh
naukūṭa chatra cāpāni tadvat sapta ṛkṣa saṃsthitaiḥ
ardhacandraḥ tu nau ādyaiḥ proktaḥ tu anya ṛkṣa saṃsthitaiḥ
eka antara gataiḥ arthāt samudraḥ ṣaṣ gṛha āśritaiḥ
vilagna ādi sthitaiḥ cakram iti ākṛti ja saṃgrahaḥ anuṣṭubh
saṃkhyā yogāḥ syuḥ sapta sapta ṛkṣa saṃsthirā eka apāyāt vallakī dāminī ca
pāśaḥ kedāraḥ śūla yogaḥ yugam ca golaḥ ca anyān pūrvam uktān vihāyaśālinī
īrṣyuḥ videśa nirataḥ adhva ruciḥ ca rajjvām mānī dhanīca muśale bahu kṛtya saktaḥ
vyaṅgaḥ sthira āḍhya nipuṇaḥ nala jaḥ sraj utthaḥ bhogāḥ anvitaḥ bhujagajaḥ bahu duḥkha bhāj syāt aṃti
āśraya uktāḥ tu viphalāḥ bhavanti anyaiḥ vimiśritāḥ
miśrāḥ yaiḥ te phalam dadyuḥ amiśrāḥ sva phala pradāḥ anuṣṭubh
yaju artha bhāj satatam artha ruciḥ gadāyām tad vṛtti bhuj śakaṭajaḥ sa rujaḥ kudāraḥ
dūtaḥ aṭanaḥ kalaha kṛt vihage pradiṣṭaḥ śṛṅgāṭake cira sukhī kṛṣikṛt hala akṣi evati
vajre antya pūrva sukhinaḥ subhagaḥ ati śūraḥ vīrya anvitaḥ api atha yave sukhitaḥ vayas antaḥ
vikhyāta kīrti amita saukhya guṇaḥ ca padma iva apyām tanu sthira sukhaḥ nidhi kṛt na dātāvati
tyāga ātmavān kratu varaiḥ yajate ca yūpe hiṃsraḥ atha gupti adhikṛtaḥ śara kṛt śara ākhye
nīcaḥ alasaḥ sukha dhanaiḥ viyutaḥ ca śaktau daṇḍe priyaiḥ virahitaḥ puruṣa antya vṛttiḥ vati
kīrti āyutaḥ cala sukhaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ cana ojaḥ kūṭe anṛta plavana bandhana paśca jātaḥ
chatra udbhavaḥ sva jana saukhya karaḥ antya saukhyaḥ śūraḥ ca kārmuka bhavaḥ prathama antya saukhyaḥ vati
ardha aindu jaḥ subhaga kānta vapuḥ pradhānaḥ toya ālaye narapati prati mastu bhogī
cakrenara aindra mukuṭa dyutiḥ añjita aṅghriḥ vīṇā udbhavaḥ ca nipuṇaḥ priya gīta nṛtyaḥ vati
dātā anya kārya nirataḥ paśu paśca dāmni pāśe dhana arjana viśīla sa bhṛtya bandhuḥ
kedārajaḥ kṛṣikaraḥ subahu upayoṣyaḥ śūraḥ kṣata udhana ruciḥ vidhanaḥ ca śūlevati
dhana virahitaḥ pākhaṇḍī vā yuge tu atha golake vidhana malinaḥ jñāna upetaḥ kuśilpī alasaḥ aṭanaḥ
iti nigaditāḥ yogāḥ sārddham phalaiḥ iha nābhasa aniyata phala dāḥ cintyā hi ete samasta daśāsu api hariṇī
candra yoga
adhama sama variṣṭhāni arka kendra ādi saṃsthe śaśini vinaya vitta jñāna dhī naipuṇāni
ahani niśi ca candre sve adhimitra aṃśake vā asura guru sita dṛṣṭe vittavān syāt sukhī ca mālinī
saumyaiḥ smara ari nidhaneṣu adhi yoga endoḥ tasmin camūpa saciva kṣitipāla janma
sampanna saukhya vibhava āhata śatravaḥ ca dīrgha āyuṣaḥ vigata roga bhayāḥ ca jātāḥ
hitvā arkam sunaphā anaphā durudhurāḥ sva antya ubhaya sthaiḥ grahaiḥ śīta aṃśoḥ kathitaḥ anyathā tu bahubhiḥ kemadrumaḥ anyaiḥ tu asau
kendre śīta kare athavā graha yute kemadrumaḥ na eṣyate kecid kendra nava aṃśakeṣu ca vadanti uktiḥ prasiddhā nateśāvi
triṃśat sarūpāḥ sunaphā anaphā ākhyāḥ ṣaṣṭi trayam daurudhure prabhedāḥ
icchā vikalpaiḥ kramaśas abhinīya nīte nivṛttiḥ punar anya nītiḥ indravajrā
svayam adhigata vittaḥ pārthivaḥ tad samaḥ uvā bhavati hi suna phāyām dhī dhana khyātimān ca
prabhuḥ agada śarīraḥ śīlavān khyāta kīrtiḥ viṣaya sukha su veṣaḥ nirvṛtaḥ ca
utpanna bhoga sukha bhuj dhana vāhana āḍhyaḥ tyāga anvitaḥ duru dhurā prabhavaḥ su bhṛtyaḥ
kema drume malina duḥkhita nīca niḥsvāḥ preṣyāḥ khalāḥ ca nṛpateḥ api vaṃśa jātāḥ vati
utsāha śaurya dhana sāhasavān mahījaḥ saumyaḥ paṭuḥ su vacanaḥ nipuṇaḥ kalāsu
jīvaḥ artha dharma sukha bhāj nṛpa pūjitaḥ ca kāmī bhṛguḥ bahu dhanaḥ viṣaya aupabhoktā ati
aśubha kṛt uḍupaḥ ahni dṛśya mūrtiḥ galita tanuḥ ca śubhaḥ anyathā anyat ūhyam puṣpita agrā
lagnāt atīva vasumān vasumān śaśa aṅkāt saumya grahaiḥ upacaya upagataiḥ samastaiḥ
dvābhyām samaḥ alpa vasumān ca tad ūna tāyām anyeṣu asatsu api phaleṣu idam utkaṭena vati
dvi graha yoga
tigmaaṃśuḥ janayati uṣeśa sahitaḥ yantra aśmakāram naram bhaumena agharatam budhena nipuṇam dhī kīrti saukhya anvitam
krūram vākpatinā anya kārya niratam śukreṇa raṅga āyudhaiḥ labdha svam ravijena dhātu kuśalam bha aṇḍa prakāreṣu vāśāvi
kūṭa strī āsava kumbha paṇyam aśivam mātuḥ sa vakraḥ śaśī sajñaḥ praśrita vākyam artha nipuṇam saubhāgya kīrtyā anvitam
vikrāntam kula mukhyam asthira matim vitta īśvaram sa aṅgirāḥ astrāṇām sa sitaḥ kriyā ādi kuśalam sa arkiḥ punarbhū sutam śāvi
mūla ādi sneha kūṭaiḥ vyavaharati vaṇij bāhu yoddhā sa saumye purī adhyakṣaḥ sa jīve bhavati narapatiḥ prāpta vittaḥ dvijaḥ vā
gopaḥ mallaḥ atha dakṣaḥ para yuvati rataḥ dyūtakṛt sa asura ijye duḥkha ārtaḥ asatya saṃdhaḥ sa savitṛ tanaye bhūmije ninditaḥ ca śavi
saumyeḥ raṅga caraḥ bṛhaspati yute gītapriyaḥ nṛtyavid vāgmī bhū gaṇapaḥ sitena mṛdunā māyā paṭuḥ laṅghakaḥ
sat vidyodhana dāravān bahu guṇaḥ śukreṇa yukte gurau jñeyaḥ śmaśrukaraḥ asitena ghaṭa kṛt jātaḥ annakāraḥ api vāśāvi
asita sita samāgame alpa cakṣuḥ yuvati samāśraya sampravṛddha vittaḥ
bhavati ca lipi pustaka citra vettā kathita phalaiḥ paratas vikalpanīyāḥ puṣpita agrāḥ
pravrajyā yoga
ekasthaiḥ catura ādibhiḥ bala yutaiḥ jātāḥ pṛthak vīrya gaiḥ śākya ājīvika bhikṣu vṛddha caraka a nirgrantha vanya aśanāḥ
māheya jña guru kṣapākara sita prābhākarīnaiḥ kramāt pravrajyā balibhiḥ sama aparajitaiḥ tad svāmibhiḥ pracyutiḥ naḥ name
ravi kupta karaiḥ a dīkṣita a balibhiḥ tad gata bhaktayaḥ narāḥ
abhiyācita mātra dīkṣita a nihataiḥ anya nirīkṣitaiḥ api vaitālīya

nairyāṇika
mṛtyuḥ mṛtyu gṛha īkṣaṇena balibhiḥ tad dhātu kopa udbhavaḥ tad saṃyukta bhaga atrajaḥ bahu bhavaḥ vīrya anvitaiḥ bhūribhiḥ
agni aṃbu āyudha jaḥ jvara āmaya kṛtaḥ tṛṣ kṣudh kṛtaḥ ca aṣṭame sūrya ādyaiḥ nidhanecara ādiṣu para sva adhva pradeśeṣu iti śāvi
śaila agra abhihatasya sūrya kujayoḥ mṛtyuḥ kha bandhu sthayoḥ kūpe manda śaśa aṅka bhūmi tanayaiḥ bandhu asta karma sthitaiḥ
kanyāyām sva janāt hima auṣṇa karayoḥ pāpa grahaiḥ dṛṣṭayoḥ syātām yadi ubhaya udaye arka śaśinau toye tadā majjitaḥ śāvi
mande karkaṭa ge jala udara kṛtaḥ mṛtyuḥ mṛga aṅke mṛge śastra agni prabhavaḥ śaśini aśubhayoḥ madhye kuja ṛkṣe sthite
kanyāyām rudhira auttha śoṣa janitaḥ tadvat sthite śītagau saura ṛkṣe yadi tadvat eva himagau rajju agni pātaiḥ kṛtaḥ
bandhāt hīna vamaḥ tayoḥ aśubhayoḥ saumya grahāt dṛṣṭayoḥ dreṣkāṇaiḥ ca sa pāśa sarpa nigaḍaiḥ chidra sthitaiḥ bandhataḥ
kanyāyām aśubha anvite astamaya ge candre site meṣa ge sūrye lagna gate ca viddhi maraṇam strī hetukam mandireśa āvi
śūla audbhinna tanuḥ sukhe avani sute sūrye api vā ākheyamesa prakṣīṇa hima aṃśubhiḥ ca yugapad pāpaiḥ trikoṇa ādya gaiḥ
bandhu sthe caravau viyati avanije kṣīṇa aindu saṃvīkṣite kāṣṭhena abhihataḥ prayāti maraṇam sūrya ātmajena īkṣita īśāvi
randhra āspada aṅga hibukaiḥ laguḍa āhata aṅgaḥ prakṣīṇa candra rudhira arki dinaīśa yuktaiḥ
taiḥ eva karma navama audayaputra saṃsthaiḥ dhūma agnibandhana śarīra nikuṭṭana antar
bandhu asta karma sahitaiḥ kuja sūrya mandaiḥ niryāṇam āyudha śikhi kṣitipāla kopāt
saura aindu bhūmi tanayaiḥ sva sukha āspada sthaiḥ jñeyaḥ kṣata kṛmi kṛtaḥ ca śarīra ghātaḥ vati
kha sthe arke avanije rasātala gate yāna prapāta dvadhaḥ yantra autpīḍana jaḥ kuje astamaya ge saura aindunā abhyudgame
viṣ madhye rudhira arki śītakiraṇaiḥ jūka aja saura ṛkṣa gaiḥ yāta iva āgalita aindu sūrya rudhiraiḥ vyoma asta bandhu āhvaya anśāvi
vīrya anvita vakra vīkṣite kṣīṇa aindau nidhana sthite arka je
guhya audbhava roga pīḍayā mṛtyuḥ syāt kṛmi śastra dāha jaḥ vaitālīya
aste ravau sa rudhire nidhane arkaputre kṣīṇe rasātalagate himagau khaga antaḥ
lagna ātmaja aṣṭama tapaḥsvina bhauma manda candraiḥ tu śaila śikhara aśani kuḍya pātaiḥ
dvāviṃśaḥ kathitaḥ tu kāraṇam dreṣkāṇaḥ nidhanasya sūribhiḥ
tasya adhipatiḥ bhavaḥ api vā niryāṇam sva guṇaiḥ prayacchati vaitālīya
horā nava aṃśaka payukta samāna bhūmau yoga īkṣaṇa ādibhiḥ atas parikalpyam etat
mohaḥ tu mṛtyu samaye anudita aṃśa tulyaḥ sva īśa īkṣite dvi guṇitaḥ triguṇaḥ śubhaiḥ cavati
dahana jala vimiśraiḥ bhasma saṃkleda śoṣaiḥ nidhana bhavana saṃsthaiḥ vyāla vargaiḥ viḍantaḥ
iti śava pariṇāmaḥ cintanīyaḥ yathā uktaḥ pṛthu viracita śāstrāt gati anūka ādi cintyam mālinī
guru ruḍupati śukrau sūrya bhaumau yamajñau vibudha pitṛ tiraścaḥ nārakīyān cakuryuḥ
dinakara śaśi vīrya adhiṣṭhitāt tryaṃśanāthāt pravara sama nikṛṣṭāḥ tuṅga hrasāt anūkemālinī
gati rapi ripu randhra tri aṃśa pa asta sthita uvā guru ratha ripu kendra chidra gaḥ sva ucca saṃsthaḥ
udayati bhavane antye saumya bhāge ca mokṣaḥ bhavati yadi balena projjhitāḥ tatra śeṣāḥ mālinī

ādhāna janma aparibodha kāle sampṛcchataḥ janma vadet vilagnāt
pūrva apara ardhe bhavanasya vindyāt bhānau udak dakṣiṇa ge prasūtim indravajrā
lagna trikoṇeṣu guruḥ tri bhāgaiḥ vikalpya varṣāṇi vayaḥ anumānāt
grīṣmaḥ arka lagne kathitāḥ tu śeṣaiḥ anyāya nartau ṛtuḥ arka cāra ātupa jātikā
canra jña jīvāḥ parivartanīyāḥ śukra āra mandaiḥ ayane vilome
dreṣkāṇabhāge prathame tu pūrvaḥ māsaḥ anupātāt ca tithiḥ vikalpyaḥ indravajrā
atra api horā paṭavaḥ dvija aindrāḥ sūrya aṃśa tulyān tithim uddiśanti
rātri dyu saṃjñeṣu viloma janmabhāgaiḥ ca velāḥ kramaśas vikalpyāḥ indravajrā
kecid śaśaaṅka adhyuṣitāt nava aṃśa chuklā aanta saṃjñam kathayanti māsam
lagna trikoṇa auttama vīrya yuktam samprocyate aṅga ālabhana ādibhiḥ vā indravajrā
yāvān gataḥ śītakaraḥ vilagnāt candrāt vadet tau ati janma rāśiḥ
mīna audaye mīna yugam pradiṣṭam bhakṣya āhṛta ākāra rutaiḥ ca cintyam indra vajrā
horā nava aṃśa pratimam vilagnam lagnāt raviḥ yāvati cadṛkāṇe
tasmāt vadet tau ati vā vilagnam praṣṭuḥ prasūtau iti śāstram āha aindra vajrā
janma ādiśet lagna ge vīrya ge vā chāyā aṅgu laghnā irka hate avaśiṣṭam
āsīna supta utthita tiṣṭha ta ābhaṃjāyā sukha ājñā udayagaṃ pradiṣṭam indravajrā
go siṃhaujituma aṣṭamaukriya tule kanyā mṛgau ca kramāt saṃvargyaḥ daśaka aṣṭa sapta viṣayaiḥ śeṣāḥ sva saṃkhyā guṇāḥ

dreṣkāṇa svarūpa
kaṭyām sita vastra veṣṭitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śaktā eva abhirakṣitum
raudraḥ paraśum samudyatam dhatte rakta vilocanaḥ pumān vaitālīyā
raktam ambara ābhūṣaṇa bhakṣya cintā kumbha ākṛtiḥ vājimukhī tṛṣā ārtā
ekena pādena ca meṣa madhye dreṣkāṇa rūpam yavana upadiṣṭam indravajrā
krūraḥ kalā jñaḥ kapilaḥ kriyā arthī bhagna vrataḥ abhyudyata daṇḍa hastaḥ
raktāni vastrāṇi bibharti caṇḍaḥ meṣe tṛtīyaḥ kathitaḥ tri bhāgaḥ indravajrā
kuñcita lūna kaca āghaṭa deha ādagdha paṭa atṛṣita a aśana cittā
ābharaṇāni abhivāñchati nārī rūpam idam vṛṣabhe prathamasya dodhaka
kṣetra dhānya gṛha dhenu kalā jñaḥ lāṅgalesa śakaṭe kuśalaḥ ca
skandham udvahati gopati tulyam kṣudh paraḥ aja vadanaḥ mala vāsā svāgatā
dvipa sama kāyaḥ pāṇḍura daṃṣṭraḥ śarabha sama aṅghriḥ piṅgala mūrtiḥ
a vimṛga lobha vyākula cittaḥ vṛṣabha vanasya prānta gataḥ ayam dodhaka
sūcyā āśrayam samabhivāñchati karma nārī rūpa anvita ābharaṇa kārya kṛta ādarāca
hīna prajā ucchrita bhuja ṛtumatī tri bhāgam ādyam tṛtīya bhavanasya vadanti tad jñāḥ
udyāna saṃsthaḥ kavacī dhanuṣmān śūraḥ astra dhārī garuḍa ānānāḥ ca
krīḍā ātmaja alaṃkaraṇa artha cintām karoti madhye mithunasya rāśeḥ upajātikā
bhūṣitaḥ varuṇa vat bahu ratnaḥ baddha tūṇa kavacaḥ sa dhanuṣkaḥ
nṛtta vādita kalā suca vidvān kāvya kṛt mithuna rāśi avasāne svāgatā
patra mūla phala bhṛt dvipa kāyaḥ kānane malaya gaḥ śarabha aṅghriḥ
kroḍa tulya vadana uhaya kaṇṭhaḥ karkaṭe prathama rūpam uśanti svāgatā
padma arcitā mūrdha nibha ugi yuktā strī karkaśa araṇya gatā virauti
śākhām palāśasya samāśritā ca madhye sthitā karkaṭakasya rāśeḥ indravajrā
bhāryā ābharaṇa artham arṇavam nau sthaḥ gacchati sarpa veṣṭitaḥ
haimaiḥ ca yutaḥ vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ci piṭa āsya aṅ tya gataḥ ca karkaṭevaitālīya
śālmaleḥ upari gṛdhra jambu kauśvānaraḥ camalinā ambara anvitaḥ
rauti mātṛ pitṛ viparyojitaḥ siṃha rūpam idam ādyam ucyate ratha uddhatā
haya ākṛtiḥ pāṇḍura mālya śekharaḥ bibharti kṛṣṇa ajina kambalam naraḥ
durāsadaḥ siṃha eva atta kārmukaḥ nata agra nāsaḥ mṛgarāja madhyamaḥ vaṃśa stha
ṛkṣa ānanaḥ vānara tulya ceṣṭaḥ bibharti daṇḍam phalam āmiṣam ca
kūrcī manuṣyaḥ kuṭilaiḥ ca keśaiḥ mṛgaḥ īśvarasya antya gataḥ tri bhāgaḥ upajātikā
puṣpa prapūrṇena ghaṭena kanyā amala pradigdha ambara saṃvṛta aṅgī
vastra artha saṃyogam abhīṣṭa mānā guroḥ kulam vāñchati kanyākaḥ ādyaḥ upajātikā
puruṣaḥ pragṛhīta lekha niḥśyāmaḥ vastra śirā vyāya yakṛt
vipulam ca bibharti kārmukam roma vyāpta tanuḥ ca madhyamaḥ vaitālīya
gaurī su dhauta agra dukūla guptā samucchritā ā kumbha kaṭacchu hastā
deva ālayam strī prayatā pravṛttā vadanti kanyā antya gataḥ tri bhāgaḥ upajātikā
vīthi antara apaṇa gataḥ puruṣaḥ tulāvān unmāna māna kuśalaḥ pratimāna hastaḥ

kalaśam parigṛhya viniṣpatitum samabhīpsati gṛdhra mukhaḥ puruṣaḥ
